leaders.bio: Serving PEFA Kenyatta for over 14 years with a heart for expository preaching, family discipleship, and Nairobi urban missions.
Leads pastoral care, women's fellowship, and new-believer foundations across Kenyatta and Ngumo estates.
Oversees church governance, community food outreach, and rural church planting partnerships across Kenya.
Stewards transparent church finances, M-Pesa giving accountability, and sanctuary building development.

sermons.title: Bold Witnesses in the Marketplace

posts.title: Welcome Home: A Fresh Season of Community Care at PEFA Kenyatta
posts.excerpt: How our small groups and KNH hospital visitation team are reaching neighbors around Kenyatta Market and Mbagathi Way.
posts.content: Over the past quarter, more than 40 families have connected into weekly home fellowships across Kenyatta Estate, Ngumo, and Woodley. Whether you are visiting Nairobi for the first time or looking for a church home near Kenyatta National Hospital, our doors and hearts are open every Sunday at 8:00 AM and 10:30 AM.
posts.author: Rev. David Mwangi

posts.title: Building Together: Phase 1 Solar & Children’s Wing Progress
posts.excerpt: Thanks to faithful M-Pesa giving toward the Building Fund, our children’s classrooms now have brighter ventilation and backup power.
posts.content: Every shilling given to the Building Fund goes directly toward creating safe, joyful spaces for PEFA Kids and dependable lighting for Friday prayer vigils. Thank you for partnering with us in prayer and generosity.
posts.author: Deaconess Esther Muthoni

testimonies.title: Peace and Provision After Job Loss
testimonies.story: When I lost my job early this year, our Ngumo cell group prayed with me every Tuesday and brought groceries without me even asking. Three months later God opened a better role at a clinic nearby.

testimonies.title: Restored Family Unity
testimonies.story: Attending the Sunday teachings on the Praying Household transformed how my wife and I communicate. We now pray together with our children every night before bed.

testimonies.title: Healing & Warm Welcome at KNH Season
testimonies.story: While my mother was admitted at Kenyatta National Hospital, PEFA Kenyatta intercessors visited us and prayed with us every evening. Today she is healthy and worshiping with us.
